stem:
Using the number tiles, Joan and Herbert played a new game.
They placed the numbers to make the largest answer.

A. Use the tiles [1], [5], and [9]. Write the numbers on the tiles in the boxes below to make the largest answer when you add.

[Image: Vertical addition layout with boxes]

descriptors: Any other arrangement of digits 1, 5, and 9
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A vertical addition problem setup with two rows above a horizontal line. The top row has two square boxes side by side. The bottom row has an addition sign (+) on the left and a single square box aligned under the right box of the top row.
